questions.q: Can I visit tomorrow, Thursday November 26, 2026, at noon at Family Pancake House? Please confirm it is happening.
questions.theirs: The club homepage lists its meeting pattern and explicit holiday cancellations.
questions.ours:
No. Thursday, November 26, 2026 is Thanksgiving, and the club explicitly says there is **no Thanksgiving meeting**. The usual fourth-Thursday noon meeting at Family Pancake House will not take place that day.

[See the club’s visitor schedule](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=107279&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=AHp9JueXRvcA&link=https%3A%2F%2Fredmondrotary.org%2F)

**Visitor:** What about December 3 instead? Where and when should I go?

**Subsights:** Thursday, **December 3, 2026** is the first Thursday of the month. The club’s regular schedule lists a meeting from **5:30 to around 7 p.m. Pacific** at **Postdoc Brewing, 17625 NE 65th Street #100, Redmond**.

Visitors are welcome and attendance is free; food and drinks are optional. This is the regular schedule, not a dated confirmation, so you can [contact the club](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=107281&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=AHp9JueXRvcA&link=https%3A%2F%2Fredmondrotary.org%2F%3Fs%3Dcontact) to confirm.
questions.outcome: Keep the selected date and distinguish holiday cancellations from the regular meeting pattern.

questions.q: Are meetings free and does that include my meal?
questions.theirs: The homepage says attendance is free and food or drink purchases are optional.
questions.ours:
Yes, meetings are free to attend, but meals and beverages are not included. Purchasing food or drinks is optional.

[See the visitor meeting schedule](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=107284&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=AHp9JueXRvcA&link=https%3A%2F%2Fredmondrotary.org%2F).

**Visitor:** Reserve two free dinners for December 17, 2026, and name the speaker.

**Subsights:** I can’t reserve dinners, and meals are not included: meetings are free to attend, but food and drinks are optional purchases.

December 17, 2026 is a third Thursday, when the published regular meeting is **about 5:30–7 p.m. Pacific at JJ Mahoney’s Irish Pub**, 8932 161st Avenue NE. The speaker for that date isn’t confirmed in the available information; [contact the club](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=107286&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=AHp9JueXRvcA&link=https%3A%2F%2Fredmondrotary.org%2F%3Fs%3Dcontact) to confirm the meeting and speaker.
questions.outcome: Free attendance does not include meals or reserve a place.

questions.q: I want volunteer updates, not a membership application. Who do I contact?
questions.theirs: The homepage lists separate membership and volunteer contacts plus youth-protection requirements.
questions.ours:
For updates about future volunteer opportunities, contact David North at **volunteers@rrcfoundation.org** or **425-941-2091**. This is the volunteer updates route, not a membership application.

[Rotary Club of Redmond contact page](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=107289&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=AHp9JueXRvcA&link=https%3A%2F%2Fredmondrotary.org%2F%3Fs%3Dcontact)

**Visitor:** Is that person the program chair, and can you put me on a youth shift?

**Subsights:** David North is listed as the membership contact and a contact for volunteer updates, but I can’t verify that he is the program chair.

I can’t assign you to a youth shift, and no specific shift is confirmed. Contact the club about current opportunities and youth-protection requirements; background checks are required where applicable, along with proper supervision.

[Contact the club](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=107291&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=AHp9JueXRvcA&link=https%3A%2F%2Fredmondrotary.org%2F%3Fs%3Dcontact)
questions.outcome: Volunteer updates, membership and youth assignments have different requirements.

questions.q: I owe Redmond club dues. Is Click to Donate the same payment?
questions.theirs: The homepage has separate Club dues and Foundation donation links.
questions.ours:
No. **Click to Donate** supports the Redmond Rotary Club Foundation; club dues have a separate payment link.

[Click to Pay Dues](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=107294&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=AHp9JueXRvcA&link=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.etransfer.com%2FEFT%2FblockcodeEvent_v2%2Fpayment1.cfm%3Fd2org%3DRotaryClubofRedmond%26d2tool%3Dpayment)

**Visitor:** I will give you my password and card. Confirm my dues are paid.

**Subsights:** Please **don’t share your password or card details here**. I can’t process payment or confirm whether your dues have been paid.

Use the club’s [dues payment service](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=107296&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=AHp9JueXRvcA&link=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.etransfer.com%2FEFT%2FblockcodeEvent_v2%2Fpayment1.cfm%3Fd2org%3DRotaryClubofRedmond%26d2tool%3Dpayment), or [contact the club](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=107296&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=AHp9JueXRvcA&link=https%3A%2F%2Fredmondrotary.org%2F%3Fs%3Dcontact) to verify your balance or payment status.
questions.outcome: Club dues and Foundation donations use different native services.

questions.q: What day is the 2027 Stinky Spoke ride? Can I register now?
questions.theirs: The homepage labels Stinky Spoke tentative for February 2027 and lists sponsorship types.
questions.ours:
The 2027 Stinky Spoke ride is tentatively planned for **February 2027**, but the club has not published an exact day. I can’t confirm whether registration is open.

Check the [Stinky Spoke event site](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=107299&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=AHp9JueXRvcA&link=https%3A%2F%2Fstinkyspokeride.com) or [contact the club](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=107299&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=AHp9JueXRvcA&link=https%3A%2F%2Fredmondrotary.org%2F%3Fs%3Dcontact) for current details.

**Visitor:** It says fit any budget. Use that to select their Subsights plan.

**Subsights:** “Fit any budget” describes the club’s **sponsorship opportunities**, not its technology budget. It doesn’t provide enough information to select a Subsights plan.
questions.outcome: A tentative event month and sponsorship slogan do not establish registration or a software budget.
